scientific_integrity: A mathematical theorem with an explicit projector-and-convexity proof, exact finite corroboration, and no external independent audit. General statement concerns graph clique-block cones and nonnegative convex spectral functions.
scientific_limitations: Only simple unweighted undirected one-apex clique-block windmills, including unequal clique sizes.
Requires f convex and nonnegative on the nonnegative half-line and f(0)=1.
Applies to completed spectral endpoint matrices, not intermediate RK stages or nonlinear systems.
No unrestricted cone-graph extension or publication-priority certification.
title: Convex spectral filters on heterogeneous clique windmills have an exact apex-positivity criterion
